headline.caveat: ~$300B over ~5 years beginning 2027, tied to 4.5GW of Stargate capacity; among the largest commercial contracts ever signed

realized_to_date.caveat: main deliveries begin 2027; OpenAI already consumes Oracle OCI capacity (Abilene) under earlier Stargate arrangements — split not disclosed

nature_md: OpenAI agreed (July 2025 capacity agreement, dollar scale reported Sept 2025) to purchase ~$300B of compute from Oracle over roughly five years starting 2027, backed by ~4.5GW of Stargate data-center capacity that Oracle is building/leasing through developers (Vantage's $25B Frontier campus, Crusoe at Abilene, Related Digital's Saline Twp MI, and JPMorgan/MUFG-financed Vantage sites). The contract single-handedly transformed Oracle's disclosed backlog: RPO jumped to $455B in Q1 FY26 (+$317B from the OpenAI agreement) and reached $638B (+363% y/y) by Q4 FY26 — more than half attributed to OpenAI by press. Payment terms, take-or-pay provisions, and cancellation rights are not public.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: A forward purchase obligation vastly exceeding OpenAI's current revenue (~$25B ARR early 2026) — unfunded, to be paid from future fundraising, IPO proceeds, and revenue growth. Not on any balance sheet today; it is a claim on OpenAI's future capital structure.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Booked into Oracle's remaining performance obligations (RPO), recognized as revenue only as capacity is delivered and consumed from 2027. Meanwhile Oracle carries the buildout cost: ~$70B FY27 net capex, $18B+$25B bond raises, and developer lease obligations — spending real money today against one customer's promise to pay later. Oracle CDS hit records with its own project-finance banks hedging via Oracle CDS.

both_sides_md: **Bear:** Oracle levered its balance sheet and credit spreads to a single unprofitable counterparty — >half of a $638B backlog from one customer whose annual losses exceed $14B (Zitron: OpenAI is the single point of failure across ~$748B of obligations; Oracle CDS at records is the market pricing this). **Bull:** RPO is contracted, not speculative; Oracle's OCI revenue is compounding as capacity lands (+363% y/y RPO converts on delivery), OpenAI's revenue is growing into the commitment, and the risk is priced — Oracle is being paid (in margin and strategic position) for taking concentration the hyperscalers refused.

observations.notes: +363% y/y; over half attributed to OpenAI per press reporting. Q1 FY26 RPO was $455B, +$317B from the OpenAI agreement.
